data.title: 帕瓦 · 阳光杂乱卧榻的晨起噘嘴
data.description: 早晨凌乱的床榻上，穿着居家睡袍的帕瓦顶着一头乱蓬蓬的金长发醒来，绯红小角从被窝钻出，气鼓鼓地踢开被子伸手索要早餐。
data.action: sitting up in bed, tousled hair, cute grumpy morning pout, reaching out
data.lighting: soft morning sun pouring over white messy sheets
data.mood: funny and intimately endearing morning routine
data.promptProse: Sitting up amidst messy white bed sheets in the golden morning light, Power rubs her eyes with a delightfully grumpy pout in cozy sleepwear, her long blonde hair charmingly disheveled.
data.animaCaption: Power waking up with adorable tousled hair and a grumpy morning pout.
